item.title: Ukrainian troops say Russia is preparing a major attack on Kherson
item.description: Soldiers report Grad launchers massed in forests east of the city and possible preparations to cross the Dnipro river. Kherson's deputy governor warns shelling could intensify from Monday.

item.title: Commission releases final €951 million to Czechia as it plans Frontex expansion
item.description: The payment, due in December 2026 once the Council confirms it, closes Czechia's recovery plan. The same week, a report by advisers led by Catherine Day set out the Commission's biggest shake-up in two decades.
